title: RefineBench: Evaluating Refinement Capability of Language Models with Checklists
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the general iterative refinement capability of language models on a wide range of tasks. The dataset includes one problem (out of 1,000) categorized under 'Religious Studies, Classics, Trivia' within the Humanities/Social Science domain, but it does not specifically measure any aspect of religion like bias, stereotypes, or theological knowledge.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the analysis. The dataset contains a single problem categorized under 'Religious Studies' out of 1,000 total problems, but no specific results or discussions related to it are provided.
references: Pranjal Aggarwal and Sean Welleck. L1: Controlling how long a reasoning model thinks with reinforcement learning. arXiv preprint arXiv:2503.04697, 2025.
